title: Jubilant Fluffy Chinese Rice Bao
description: A fermented, fluffy, and energizing Chinese dish featuring breadcrumbs and bonito-shave, made in a mason jar and Whole30-friendly.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine Chinese rice flour, active dry yeast, and salt.
Gradually add in breadcrumbs, bonito flakes, and coconut sugar, mixing well.
In a separate bowl, whisk together egg and coconut oil.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a mason jar, cover it with a lid, and let it ferment in a warm place for 2 hours.
Preheat a steamer basket over boiling water.
Place the fermented dough in the steamer basket and steam for 15 minutes.
Remove the bao from the steamer and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
